name: Meerkat Finance
rootCause: An impressive debut for the first major exploit on BSC, as Meerkat Finance head straight to number three on our leaderboard. Will CZ and team roll back their corporate chain, or allow their users to suffer the loss? This suricate scam leaves the thieves with nowhere to hide.

descriptions.text: An impressive debut for the first major exploit on BSC, as Meerkat Finance head straight to number three on our leaderboard. Will CZ and team roll back their corporate chain, or allow their users to suffer the loss? This suricate scam leaves the thieves with nowhere to hide.

According to the official community information of Meerkat Finance, its vault contract was hacked, and the hacker used the loophole to steal all the funds in the vault. According to reports, the BSC project Meerkat Finance is suspected of running away and swept away about 31 million US dollars, of which 14 million BUSD and the other 73,000 BNB. MKAT claims to have been hacked to steal all resources.

Meerkat Finance on BNB Smart Chain lost about $31.56 million on 2021-03-04 after its deployer upgraded both vault proxies to malicious implementations that let an attacker initialize ownership and sweep the vault balances. The deployer retained proxy upgrade control and used it to install malicious vault implementations. The new logic exposed an unprotected initializer that set the owner in storage and an owner-only sweep function that withdrew the vault's full token balance.
